notes.title: Update 2024.7.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this new update, the internal handling of the game's resolution has been improved, allowing the game to adapt much better to different monitors.

Additionally, taking advantage of this modification, all the game's menus have been reviewed to make them clearer and more intuitive.

notes.title: Update 2024.5.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This new update includes:

[list]
[*] Adjustments to event frequency.
[*] Balance changes to enemy difficulty.
[*] Major performance improvements.
[*] Ability to disable shadows to improve game performance.
[*] Added some new camera effects.
[*] Fixed or added some translations.
[*] Fixed many bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]New Tribu update![/h3]

In this update the performance of the game has been improved and many bugs fixed.

[olist]
[*]Performance improvements
[list]
[*]General performance improvements.
[*]Now stable performance is maintained during long gaming sessions.
[*]Entering and exiting caves is much faster.
[*]Optimized the lighting system.
[*]Optimized data saving.
[*]Assaults now load faster.
[/list]

[*]AI improvements
[list]
[*]Improved NPC AI in assaults so that NPCs don't get stuck.
[*]Improved the AI of the animals in the world.
[*]Improved the AI of the NPCs that follow the player.
[/list]

[*]Bug fixes
[list]
[*]Buildings no longer disappear.
[*]Mounts no longer disappear.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused many events to not be activated.
[*]Infinite animals are no longer generated in areas (affecting performance).
[*]Item recipes now load correctly.
[*]Many more errors.
[/list]

[/olist]

I hope that with this Tribu version it will be a more polished and fun experience for everyone.
There are also new quests lined up coming this year!

notes.title: v2.3.0 - New Update!
notes.notes:
In this update, we have worked to adjust and fix various aspects of the game based on the feedback received in recent weeks.

Here are the new features:

[list]
[*] You can now challenge another tribal chief to a deadly duel. Winning the duel counts as an additional assault!
[*] Improved the guidance system to make it easier to locate the designated target. It's necessary to have a pierced stone in the inventory!
[*] The game's AI has been improved.
[*] Day duration has been adjusted, allowing you more time to explore and gather resources.
[*] You can now enhance the statistics of your character and tribe members using fervor points.
[*] Some buildings now require periodic maintenance to ensure their functionality.
[*] Prices of abilities and rituals have been adjusted.
[*] MANY bugs have been fixed.

[/list]

notes.title: v2.0.0 - New Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome back to Tribu![/h1]

We are excited to announce our latest game update, which brings a number of improvements and new features that will make the gaming experience even more enjoyable.

In this update, we have added a new feature: fishing, which allows players to catch fish throughout the Aurk Valley.

Additionally, we have added a new cooking skill, which means you can now prepare your own food and experiment with different recipes.

Read on to learn more details about these improvements and features:

[h2]Cooking[/h2]
You can cook food. Cooked food gives more benefits to those who consume it and also eliminates negative effects of some ingredients.
It is also possible to create brews with different foods. Some are very powerful!

[h2]Fishing[/h2]
Now you can fish in any lake or river!
Fish are food that your tribe can use as sustenance. They can also be used for creating brews and advanced food using the campfire.
There are different types of fish, and some can only be caught in specific areas or with specific items in the inventory.

[h2]Buildings[/h2]
The worktable has been added, which allows you to create more arrows with fewer resources, fire bombs, and poison bombs (be careful with them!).

[h2]Status[/h2]
Now characters can have statuses: they can be tired, hungry, well-fed, blessed by the gods...
There are statuses that give benefits and others that give negative effects.

[h2]New items[/h2]
Fish, more types of food, brews, mushrooms (be careful when eating them), and bombs have been added.

[h2]Exploration[/h2]
If you have a Horada Stone (a stone that allows you to see the fairies of the Aurk Valley) in your character's inventory, a fairy will guide you to your tribe's camp or the camp indicated in the task menu.

[h2]Game settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved game control display
[*] Audio volume levels
[/list]

[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] New help menu
[*] Throwing stones!
[*] Fixed various bugs
[*] Improved compatibility with controllers
[*] Collisions with objects and characters have been disabled to improve mobility.
[*] Hunger decreases more during the day.
[/list]

We would also love to hear your feedback and thoughts on our future updates, so we have created a new [url=https://discord.gg/jW9yXNURRF][b]Discord[/b][/url] channel.
